Bincika hukumar amsa a sama don abin da ta ce a zahiri; idan ba komai ba ne ko kuma kawai yarda, wannan tsarin na iya karɓar buƙatar amma ƙin ko watsi da abin da aka biya a ciki (sunaye / tsarin filin da ba daidai ba don API sa, filin da ake buƙata a gefen sa wanda wannan kayan aikin ba ya haɗa da, da sauransu).

push.title: Webhooks Yanar Gizo masu fita - Tura Jagoran & Sabuntawa
push.intro: Za'a iya daidaita shi sosai ta kowane webhook : JSON , Form (x-www-form-urlencoded), ko samfurin jikin ku na Custom tare da <fieldkey></fieldkey> masu riƙe wuri (misali <example></example> ) - yana aiki kamar cika umarnin cURL sau ɗaya.

push.curlHelp: Manna misalin buƙatar takaddun API ɗin su ko Postman yana ba ku (tare da ainihin ko samfurin bayanai). URL , hanya da masu kai suna kwafi kamar yadda yake, kuma kowane maɓalli a cikin jiki an jera su a ƙasa don haka zaku iya zaɓar wane filin CRM ya cika shi ga kowane jagorar.

push.howFilled: Yadda ake cika dabi'u: ana sake amfani da wannan webhook ga kowane jagora - Leadrat ba ta aika misali mai tsauri ba, tana aika sabon turawa duk lokacin da wani taron da aka zaɓa ya faru, tare da WANAN darajojin halin yanzu.

api.title: API ɗinku - Samun Hanyoyi Biyu don Kowane Tsari
api.intro: Duk wani tsari tare da maɓallin API ɗinku na iya ƙirƙira, karantawa da sabunta jagora da biyan kuɗi don jagorantar abubuwan da suka faru. Aika maɓalli a cikin taken <hdr></hdr> , azaman <bearer></bearer> , ko (idan kayan aikin ba zai iya saita taken kai) azaman <query></query> . Iyaka: {{limit}} buƙatun a minti daya.
api.noPermission: Wani mai izinin Sarrafa Saituna ne kawai zai iya duba maɓallin API .
api.shownOnce: Kwafi wannan maɓallin yanzu kuma adana shi a wani wuri mai aminci - don tsaro ana nuna shi sau ɗaya kawai. Idan ya ɓace, haifar da sabo.
api.regenerateConfirm: Ƙirƙirar sabon maɓallin API ? Maɓallin na yanzu yana daina aiki nan da nan don kowane tsarin amfani da shi.
api.openApiHint: Shigo da OpenAPI spec cikin Postman , Zapier , Make ko n8n don samun kowane ƙarshen shiri don amfani.
